en: One liter of boiling liquid water expands into approximately 1,700 liters of water vapor gas.
At room temperature, 100 milliliters of water can dissolve up to 200 grams of table sugar.
A cubic centimeter of solid gold weighs 19.3 grams, making it 19 times heavier than the same volume of water.
When iron metal rusts, it combines with oxygen and expands its volume by up to six times.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all metals, remaining solid until it reaches 3,422 degrees Celsius.
One liter of average ocean seawater contains about 35 grams of dissolved salt.
Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, scoring a perfect ten on the Mohs scale, while talc scores a one.
Plasma is the most common state of matter, making up over 99 percent of the visible universe.
Reacting one teaspoon of baking soda with vinegar produces about 1.3 liters of carbon dioxide gas.
When liquid water freezes into solid ice, its volume expands by about nine percent.
A single common plastic water bottle can take up to 450 years to fully decompose in a landfill.
Earth's atmosphere is a gas mixture containing approximately 78 percent nitrogen and 21 percent oxygen by volume.
